hmek001.name: Titan Hammer
hmek001.description: A frontline juggernaut armed with immense firepower and reinforced armor plating.
hmek001.appearance: A two-legged heavy mech with thick, layered armor plates and oversized actuator housings. Its steel-gray surfaces are accented with black trim and reinforced hand assemblies.

hmek002.name: Dread Bastion
hmek002.description: A fortress on legs, designed to absorb immense damage while controlling the battlefield.
hmek002.appearance: A four-legged heavy chassis with thick armored limbs and a massive central torso. Its matte dark finish is accentuated with red warning stripes and multiple reinforced weapon hardpoints.

hmek003.name: Thunder Colossus
hmek003.description: A walking artillery platform capable of unleashing devastating long-range barrages.
hmek003.appearance: A tracked artillery platform with a broad armored chassis and multiple large-caliber weapon mounts. Its rugged industrial styling includes dark gray plating and yellow hazard striping.

hmek004.name: Goliath Enforcer
hmek004.description: An elite suppression unit, built for enduring engagements and area control.
hmek004.appearance: A four-legged assault frame with reinforced leg actuators and a broad torso mounting multiple weapon hard points. Steel gray armor is accented with red combat striping and heavily layered plating.

hmek005.name: Onyx Warlord
hmek005.description: A relentless war machine, engineered for brutal assaults and frontline dominance.
hmek005.appearance: A two-legged heavy assault mech with four reinforced arms and a glossy black finish. Red accent lines highlight its aggressive silhouette and heavy armor plating.

hmek006.name: Hellstorm Titan
hmek006.description: A walking inferno, equipped with flame-based weaponry for area-wide destruction.
hmek006.appearance: A four-legged heavy platform with a reinforced chassis and integrated flamethrower mounts. Its armor plates are finished in red and orange, with visible heat vents around its weapon systems.

hmek007.name: Crimson Juggernaut
hmek007.description: A terrifying siege unit designed to break enemy lines with overwhelming force.
hmek007.appearance: A four-legged siege chassis with thick crimson armor plating and reinforced limb joints. Black accent panels surround heavy weapon mounts and structural supports.

hmek008.name: Vanguard Behemoth
hmek008.description: A defensive stronghold, built to withstand relentless attacks and outlast any opponent.
hmek008.appearance: A four-legged defensive platform with heavy armor plating and a low, wide torso. Its steel-gray surfaces are accented with red markings and multiple defensive hardpoints.

hmek009.name: Storm Leviathan
hmek009.description: A towering battlefield menace, combining energy-based offense with unmatched resilience.
hmek009.appearance: A tracked heavyweight frame with a tall, armored superstructure and integrated energy weapon arrays. Its hull features reinforced plating and glowing energy conduits.

hmek010.name: Iron Tyrant
hmek010.description: A walking war fortress, capable of crushing enemies with relentless firepower and impenetrable armor.
hmek010.appearance: A four-legged juggernaut with a massive armored torso and multiple weapon mounts. Its heavy plates are layered for maximum protection, and its joints are reinforced with thick actuator housings.
